verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an off-ramp that converts crypto to cash paid to a bank account or Visa card, through a user-driven sell flow with payout method selection and requote webhooks. Nothing in the evidence shows merchant-side acceptance of crypto payments or automatic conversion of stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or settlement, so the business would hold crypto until someone manually sells it. Missing for 10: merchant crypto-payment acceptance, automatic stablecoin-to-fiat settlement option, fiat merchant balance or scheduled bank payout docs, independent corroboration.
